entries.f00600cff2d4e8c7: The company sets out "promotion of a new sales strategy" and "expansion of production capacity" as priority issues. In sales, the company states that it will promote expanded sales of high-value-added blowers, vacuum pumps, and repairs, and work on expanded sales of large blowers with special specifications using the technological capabilities it has cultivated through long years of experience, and on provision of solutions according to customers' usage processes. In production, the company states that it will advance shortening of production lead times through advancement of production planning, renovation of large processing equipment, and development of multi-skilled workers, and will steadily advance completion of a new machining building in 2027 and a new assembly building in 2028. As its vision, the company also states that it aims to be a company with No.1 customer trust as a vacuum pump professional.
